strings.method.title: How we calculated
strings.fine.what_if: A what-if, not an invoice: nobody is billed these dollars. We convert the tokens Gisting avoids at Claude’s published input price, to show the scale. Gisting is trained into a model you run yourself; a hosted API can’t switch it on.
strings.fine.caching: With prompt caching, repeated rule text is billed at the cache-read price, so the dollar saving here is about a tenth of the list-price figure. A cache only helps while a prefix is reused within 5 minutes, so at low volume list price is likelier. The shorter context holds either way.
strings.fine.haiku: {model} can’t cache a prompt this short (minimum {min} tokens), so its two figures match. Cache writes are not counted.
strings.fine.input_only: Input tokens only. The numbers come from our own, deliberately tough test cases; real traffic will differ.
strings.fine.no_speed_claim: Fewer tokens is not a claim of speed.

strings.rules.heading: The full service rules
strings.rules.intro: This is the text Gist mode replaces with 16 trained tokens. Security doesn’t depend on hiding it: order verification, rate limits and handoff consent are enforced in code.
strings.tools.title: The tools the agent can call
strings.tools.intro: The agent can act only through these three tools, and the model sees these definitions in both modes. To look up an order it needs the order number and the email address for that order. Handing you to our team and the shipping reminder are demos: nothing is sent and nobody follows up.

strings.train.distil_text: Only 16 gist tokens are trained: 16 × 2048 = 32,768 numbers. The model’s own weights don’t move.

strings.privacy.title: What OpenGisting keeps, and what it doesn’t.
strings.privacy.ip: We don’t keep your IP address. To stop abuse and to limit how many requests and wrong order lookups one source can make, we keep only a code worked out from it, for 24 hours at most. We never put it in our own logs.
strings.privacy.counters: We also keep a few plain tallies so the limits can work: messages sent in a chat, uses of the compare button, requests from one source today, and a daily total for the whole site. Wrong order lookups are tallied too, to slow down guessing. Tallies are only numbers, never what you typed, and are kept for 24 hours at most. The wrong-lookup tally lives only in the chat server’s memory and is wiped whenever that server restarts.
strings.privacy.totals: The running total of tokens saved in your chat, and the savings calculator on this page, are worked out in your browser. Nothing from them is sent to us or stored, and the calculator collects no data.
strings.privacy.chat: What you type is used only to write the reply. The chat server remembers the conversation while you are active and forgets it after 15 minutes of silence. It isn’t saved to disk or written to logs.
strings.privacy.not_collected: We do not collect your name, an account, or any real customer data. Orders here are test data in a Shopify store; please do not type real personal data into the chat. We do not sell data, run ads, or track you across sites, and chat content is not used to train models.
strings.privacy.processors: Your messages are answered by our own model, not by an outside AI company. Order lookups go to a Shopify store that holds only test data. Before your first message, Cloudflare runs a quick check that you are a person, not a bot (the site’s Privacy page says what Cloudflare sees).
strings.privacy.turnstile: The bot check before your first message loads a script and a small frame from Cloudflare (challenges.cloudflare.com). To tell people from bots, Cloudflare processes signals from your browser and connection, such as your IP address, browser type and connection details, and may use them to improve its bot detection. We only receive a pass or fail verdict, not those signals. In our tests the check set no cookies, but Cloudflare’s frame keeps one item in your browser’s local storage for challenges.cloudflare.com, which our site cannot read.
strings.privacy.logs: The chat server keeps a basic activity log for up to 7 days: when something happened, how long it took, whether it worked or what error came up, and a short tag for your chat that stops matching once the server restarts. It never contains what you typed, order numbers, email addresses, your IP address or the code made from it.
